source.method: Current route pieces isolated by route distance; level, horizontal orthographic camera. Distant city and other legs are excluded. Street bends are separate wider elevations; the winding route is unfolded in travel order, so bends and changes of scale do not join seamlessly.

districts.title: the Mouth
districts.note: Sanjō Ōhashi, a hidden tunnel roji, and the first shops of rakuchū

districts.title: the Alley Maze
districts.note: yuka river decks, narrow geiko zushi, vine trellises and crooked ridges

districts.title: the Water Maze
districts.note: two cargo takasebune, willow fronds, bridge culverts and cherry boughs

districts.title: the Long Canopy
districts.note: Teramachi lanterns, stained-glass vaults, rafter catwalks and skylights

districts.title: Laundry Sky
districts.note: drying decks, folks hanging yukata, tunnel lanes, futons and high cisterns

districts.title: Festival Streets
districts.note: bustling yatai stalls, folding screens, a kakiyama and the great hoko float

districts.title: Castle Gardens
districts.note: paved terraces, castle moats, stone walls, and samurai watchtowers

districts.title: Theater District
districts.note: wooden balconies, hanging curtains, painted signs and lantern glow

districts.title: Market Row
districts.note: covered aisles, hanging lanterns, food stalls and crowd noise

districts.title: Golden Reflection
districts.note: water towers, lotus ponds, moss roofs and gilded spires

districts.title: Willow Way
districts.note: weeping branches, stone lamps, bridge railings and evening mist

districts.title: Shrine Steps
districts.note: stone stairs, torii gates, ema boards and firelight on the hills

districts.title: the Sending Fires
districts.note: five fires on the Kyoto hills, across the roofs you ran
